summary: Healthcare Triangle, Inc. (HCTI) filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting a September 22, 2026 First Amendment to its June 12, 2026 Equity Purchase Agreement with Hudson Global Ventures, LLC, a Nevada LLC investor. The Amendment redefines Purchase Price and Valuation Period, cuts the maximum amount per Put Notice from $2.5M to $250K, raises the minimum price-per-share threshold from $0.01 to $0.10, and adds a Change of Control provision barring further Put Notices after such a transaction. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This modifies an existing equity line facility, not a standalone change-of-control or tender event.
